summary: Wrote plan.md (all coordinates, no build or render yet). Natural History: a grey-white granite ring of ranges with a 6-column portico, a pediment at y 22 and a low green copper dome at y 26 on a drum centred at x 57, plus hipped red roofs. American History: a long, low pink marble box (6:1, like the real one) with panels and window slots, a deep unbroken cornice band and a glowing clerestory and atrium. African American History: a bronze corona of three tiers stepping out 1 block per tier, copper-grate lattice glowing amber over a recessed glass base, a porch canopy and reflecting pools.
